blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) suspends the issuance of permits for public events ahead of the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, scheduled for Nov. 16 to 18. The suspension covers fun runs, motorcades, processions, and similar public events scheduled from Oct. 24 to Nov. 19 in areas affected by the Asean Summit. It will apply to parts of Manila, Pasay, Taguig (particularly Bonifacio Global City), Parañaque, and Makati.
